"I believe there's a reason for everything; it just wasn't meant to be for her," she explained of Aimee's decision against participating in the family's wildly successful reality show, " The Osbournes ." KELLY OSBOURNE SAYS SHE 'WASN'T WELL' WHILE FACING HARSH SCRUTINY, BODY-SHAMING AFTER DAD OZZY'S DEATH "It was always me and Jack," she said. "If I'm honest, my older sister didn't really ever acknowledge me and my brother. She was just in her own world doing her own thing. "And I do, to a certain extent, if I'm honest, feel as though she was embarrassed of us... the whole family."
